posts.text:
Remember: Democracy goes through periods of expansion and periods of contraction.

We are in a moment of sharp contraction.

But if we raise our voices together, we will emerge stronger from this moment.
Donald Trump and his cronies are trying to dismantle this country and sell it for parts. We cannot, and we will not let them.
You can't celebrate Dr. King's legacy once a year in January and then spend the rest of the year trying to attack and dismantle his legacy.
People in this country don't have health care right now because our leaders decided funding for ICE and war was more important.

I know times feel dark right now. 
 
But now is not the time to give in to despair. 
 
Do not let cynical forces convince you that they have already won. 
 
The arc of history is long, but it bends towards justice.

We can afford to end hunger in this country.
We know how to do it.
We could get it done now.

Our leaders are choosing not to.

I just voted YES on a resolution to end the Iran war.

Months ago, we were told this war would be over in a few weeks.

It has become clear that there is no exit plan. Let's end this war TODAY.

Trump’s Supreme Court has gutted the protections that Dr. King marched for. 

The protections made possible by civil rights protestors who spilled blood in pursuit of a more perfect union.

This is a devastating and profound step backwards for American Democracy.
Instead of spending $70 billion MORE on ICE, why don't we use that money to help millions of young people buy their first home?

Mike, why don't you log off and call Speaker Johnson? Tell him to put the bipartisan bill we BOTH supported up for a vote. He can end this shutdown today.


Mike Lee (@BasedMikeLee)

The best way to thank the Secret Service is to fully fund DHS

End this shutdown



— https://nitter.net/BasedMikeLee/status/2048261706762363276#m

I joined first responders in prayer this afternoon as they work to battle the wildfires that are active in Brantley County and southern Georgia. 

These crews are doing heroic work to protect lives and property. 

Check in on your neighbors and stay safe, Georgia.

There is nothing NICE about an unchecked paramilitary force killing Americans and trampling on our fundamental freedoms.

We don't need a rebrand, we need accountability and we need guardrails.

Thank you to law enforcement for stopping the gunman at tonight’s White House Correspondents’ Dinner.

Political violence has no place in America. Praying for healing in our nation.

It's almost like the President is trying to make your life more expensive. 

Yet, Trump grades the economy an "A+++++" 

Maybe if you're one of his billionaire buddies.

They're trying to gaslight you.

Video
What does it say about our country that we are cutting cancer research for kids while increasing funding for bullets and bombs?

Unlimited billions for ICE and for war. But nothing for ordinary people trying to make their lives work.

Video

Our leaders just approved billions MORE for ICE.

That money could have funded:

Universal Pre-K
Free Community College
Down payment assistance for millions
